overview: TradeNest Naturals is an FSSAI-licensed manufacturer and IEC-registered exporter delivering premium dehydrated wheat grass powder from India. Sourced from selected young shoots, our powder is processed through a strict six-step method including controlled drying, grinding, and sieving. The resulting 80-100 mesh powder offers a vibrant green profile, low moisture content, and uniform dispersibility for modern industrial formulations.

We support global distributors, brands, and processors with reliable bulk supplies and private-label contract manufacturing. Starting at an accessible MOQ of 5 kg, our operations provide full export documentation support, customizable particle sizes, and tailored packaging solutions. Every dispatch undergoes rigorous quality inspection, ensuring dependable batch-to-batch consistency and a stable twenty-four month shelf life for your manufacturing needs.
highlights: Manufactured from dehydrated young shoots with natural green appearance
Milled to an 80-100 mesh size for rapid and uniform dispersion
Maintains a strictly controlled moisture level of 5.0% or less
Offers an extended shelf life of 24 months under cool storage
Flexible procurement with a low minimum order quantity of 5 kg
Full batch traceability through our systematic six-step production process

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for this product?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 kg, making it accessible for product formulation trials, custom blends, and full commercial production runs.

faqs.q: What packaging formats are available for bulk and retail buyers?
faqs.a: We offer bulk supplies in 25 kg bags and HDPE containers, intermediate 5 to 10 kg bags, as well as customized private-label pouches and jars.

faqs.q: Do you offer OEM and private label services?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide end-to-end OEM and private label solutions, including customized particle sizes, mesh specifications, and branded retail packaging.

faqs.q: What steps are involved in your manufacturing process?
faqs.a: We operate a standardized six-step process encompassing sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and dispatch.

faqs.q: Can we obtain product samples prior to placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, product samples are available upon request to assist with laboratory testing, compatibility assessments, and pilot formulation trials.

faqs.q: Do you offer documentation support for international shipments?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we provide full export documentation support to ensure smooth customs clearance and compliant international transport.
